Ensure every request created by this flow carries the credential so repeated gate checks use the authenticated rate limit. - Line 66: Update the comment and review list retrieval in the PR gate, including the get call around the pulls/{args.pr}/comments endpoint and the corresponding reviews request, to follow all GitHub pagination pages instead of limiting results to the first 100. Apply the existing filters and CLEAN decision only after both complete lists have been collected. - Around line 97-98: Update the mergeability classification near pr.get("mergeable_state") so a null pr.get("mergeable") is treated as pending or unknown rather than appended to problems. Return the existing pending exit status (2), or reuse the script’s established retry flow before evaluating mergeable_state; retain the current failure handling for definitively non-clean results. Review comments at @src/core/Session.cpp: - Around line 224-233: Update the kExportExt allowlist used by isReadOnlyExportSavePath to include the markdown and htm extensions, so read-only document_save requests for both supported export formats are permitted while preserving the existing extensions. - Around line 820-822: Move the hide_if validation from the paragraph-specific path into the shared validateBlock block-ingress boundary so insert_blocks, replace_range, and native JSON open enforce it consistently. In validateBlock, reject expressions that reference page or pages and reject invalid expressions, evaluating them with the available document context while preserving the existing document_validate behavior. - Around line 820-827: Move the hide_if validation currently using hideIfExprUsesPageOrPages and FieldExpr::evaluate ahead of applyParagraphFormat’s pushUndo and formatting loop. Ensure invalid expressions return through fail before any block properties, dirty state, or undo history are modified, while preserving the existing successful formatting behavior. After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr ```
